statements.subject: participant
statements.description: As a clarification to the calculation of the A2 value for message integrity assurance in the Digest authentication scheme, implementers should assume, when the entity-body is empty (that is, when the RTSP messages have no message body) that the hash of the message body resolves to the hash of an empty string, or: H(entity-body), example MD5("") = "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e".
